CREATE INDEX gaps_sym_to ON gaps(symbol, to_ms)
CREATE INDEX verify_1m_sym_min ON verify_1m(symbol, ts_min)
CREATE TABLE backfill_1m(symbol TEXT, ts_min INTEGER, source TEXT, n_rows INTEGER, tape_qty REAL, kline_qty REAL, rel_err REAL, ok INTEGER, attempts INTEGER, note TEXT, done_at TEXT)
CREATE TABLE gaps(symbol TEXT, from_ms INTEGER, to_ms INTEGER, reason TEXT)
CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT, value TEXT)

CREATE TABLE trade_tape_1s(symbol TEXT, ts_sec INTEGER, price_bin INTEGER, buy_qty REAL, sell_qty REAL, buy_n INTEGER, sell_n INTEGER, buy_max REAL, sell_max REAL, retail_buy_qty REAL, retail_sell_qty REAL, whale_buy_qty REAL, whale_sell_qty REAL, whale_buy_n INTEGER, whale_sell_n INTEGER, retail_buy_n INTEGER, retail_sell_n INTEGER, order_buy_n INTEGER, order_sell_n INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (symbol, ts_sec, price_bin)) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE verify_1m(symbol TEXT, ts_min INTEGER, tape_qty REAL, kline_qty REAL, rel_err REAL, checked_at TEXT)

CREATE VIEW footprint_5m AS
                SELECT symbol,
                       ts_sec - (ts_sec % 300)                     AS bar_start,
                       CAST(round(price_bin / 5.0) AS INTEGER)     AS price_bin_5,
                       round(price_bin / 5.0) * 0.5                AS price,
                       sum(buy_qty)          AS buy_qty,
                       sum(sell_qty)         AS sell_qty,
                       sum(whale_buy_qty)    AS whale_buy_qty,
                       sum(whale_sell_qty)   AS whale_sell_qty,
                       sum(retail_buy_qty)   AS retail_buy_qty,
                       sum(retail_sell_qty)  AS retail_sell_qty,
                       sum(buy_n)            AS fill_buy_n,
                       sum(sell_n)           AS fill_sell_n,
                       sum(order_buy_n)      AS order_buy_n,
                       sum(order_sell_n)     AS order_sell_n
                FROM trade_tape_1s
                GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
